_comment: Wheel-source freshness fingerprint (DEC-FNOMATH-WHEEL-FRESHNESS-001 — the fno_math twin of trading_core's R2-CC-G1 fingerprint). The crate version + sorted compiled-symbol surface the CURRENT source tree is expected to expose. Read by `brutex doctor`'s wheel_freshness_fno_math stage and pinned equal to fno_math._EXPECTED_COMPILED_SYMBOLS by tests. Update this file in the SAME commit as any rust/fno-math surface or version change. HONEST envelope (Golden Rule #10): version + symbol-set checks catch a stale wheel that dropped/added a symbol or changed crate version; same-version symbol-compatible behavioral drift is now watched by the SHIPPED source-digest handshake (DEC-RUST-SOURCE-DIGEST-TWIN-001, MIGRATION.md #1258) — build.rs bakes the crate-source BLAKE3 FRAMING-v1 digest into the compiled module as `__source_digest__`, and `brutex doctor`'s wheel_source_digest_fno_math stage compares it (WARN, non-fatal) against the Python-twin recompute over the repo crate tree; behavioral correctness itself is proven by LAYERED nets, each with a stated reach (the refuter-round-5 honesty fix, MIGRATION.md #1928 — a 1-ULP fold-op-order mutant WHEEL passed every pre-round-5 Python-side parity/golden test, so 'the CI golden/parity suites remain the behavioral correctness proof' was an over-claim for that class): the in-crate cargo bit-level tests (exact-value pins + the bitwise refold proptest, weekly cargo-mutants-gated) prove the kernels' float op order at the RUST-SOURCE level, and the CI Python-side parity suites carry ULP-boundary discriminators (nextafter-bracketed thresholds at achieved fold Sharpes over non-power-of-2 group counts) that kill rounding-order drift in the shipped WHEEL itself — value-level golden/parity cases alone provably could not. This file deliberately does NOT list `__source_digest__` in `symbols` nor pin a digest value: a pinned value would go stale on every src commit, and the stamp's dunder-invisibility to the symbol-set check keeps old/new wheel × old/new doctor combinations interoperable. The residual `python/` shim-staleness gap (FRAMING v1 excludes the shim the wheel packages) is the named FRAMING-v2 follow-up.
